description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'TemporalExpression' within the OFBiz framework that represents a temporal (time-based) expression. It includes methods for evaluating, comparing, and manipulating temporal expressions, such as finding the first or next occurrence of the expression on a given date, checking if a date is included, and obtaining ranges of matching dates.

classes.name: TemporalExpression
classes.description: An abstract class representing a temporal expression, providing core functionality for subclasses that specify concrete temporal conditions.

methods.name: getSequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence value used for sorting temporal expressions.

methods.name: setSequence
methods.description: Sets the sequence value used for sorting.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing the TemporalExpressionVisitor interface for visitor pattern.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this expression to another based on the sequence value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on 'id' and 'sequence'.

methods.name: containsExpression
methods.description: Indicates whether the expression contains another expression (default false).

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first occurrence of the expression on or after a given date.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the expression.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Returns a set of dates within a specified range that match the expression.

methods.name: includesDate
methods.description: Checks if a specific date is included in this expression.

methods.name: isSubstitutionCandidate
methods.description: Indicates whether the expression could produce a specific date based on a candidate expression.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next occurrence of the expression after a given date.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique ID for this expression.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the expression.
